tips.alert.lead: What shows up in the stream when a donation arrives.
tips.alert.test_failed: Nothing sent. Text and video are both empty, or no overlay is listening.
tips.alert.test_hint: These values are for the test only and are not saved.
tips.alert.test_sent: Test sent – have a look at the overlay.
tips.alert.test_while_all_off: Alerts are switched off entirely – this test would not arrive.
tips.alert.tiers_hint: One alert per tier. The highest tier whose minimum is reached wins – if the donation is below all of them, the lowest applies.
tips.alert.title: Alert on a donation
tips.alert.toggle_hint: Turn the donation alert on or off
tips.appearance_lead: Markup and stylesheet of the donation bar in the overlay.
tips.bind.fill: The progress bar – its width comes from both amounts.
tips.bind.title: The name of the running goal.
tips.cancelled: The donation was cancelled – nothing was charged.
tips.confirm_delete: Really delete the goal “%{name}”? The amount collected so far goes with it.
tips.empty: No donation goal yet. Create one – on the donation page the donor picks what their donation goes to.
tips.error.goal_gone: This donation goal no longer exists. Please pick another one.
tips.error.no_identity: Twitch did not return a channel for this login. Please try again.
tips.error.no_provider: This payment method is not available right now. Please pick another one.
tips.error.not_signed_in: The login has expired. Please sign in with Twitch again.
tips.error.start_failed: The payment could not be started right now. Please try again in a moment.
tips.error.terms: Without accepting the terms and the privacy policy this cannot continue.
tips.error.too_large: This page does not accept more than %{max} € per donation.
tips.format_hint: data-format="euro" shows amounts with two decimals and a currency sign, data-format="int" as a whole number.
tips.is_default: The shipped appearance is in use. As soon as you save something, your version applies – and fixes to the default will no longer reach you.
tips.last_failed: Something went wrong with a payment last time:
tips.legal_hint: The plugin does not ship this text – it is yours. An imprint carries your name and address; a plugin bringing one along would spread your details to everyone who installs it.
tips.legal_markdown: Markdown is allowed: ## for headings, * for lists, a blank line for a paragraph.
tips.missing_hint: Required elements are missing from the markup – it was saved anyway:
tips.name: Tip-Goals
tips.needs_imprint: Without an imprint the donation page stays closed. A page that accepts money has to say who receives it.
tips.needs_provider: No payment provider is installed – without one the donation page stays closed. Install “Tip-Goals - PayPal”, for example.
tips.no_provider_ready: No payment provider is set up – the donation page accepts nothing right now. Set up:
tips.no_script_hint: script, iframe, object, embed, style and attributes like onclick are stripped from the markup – this is about appearance.
tips.perm.edit: may create, change, move and delete donation goals and set up the donation page and payment providers.
tips.providers_hint: Each provider is a plugin of its own and is set up there. If more than one is accepting, the donor chooses.
tips.public.anonymous: Your name will not show up in the stream - the donation still will.
tips.public.closed_hint: This page is not accepting donations at the moment. Come back later.
tips.public.footer: Straight to %{name}, with no platform in between - only the payment provider's own fees apply.
tips.public.heading: Support %{name}
tips.public.lead: Straight to the streamer, no platform in between. Your Twitch name appears in the stream if you want it to.
tips.public.message_hint: Shown with the donation alert in the stream.
tips.public.message_placeholder: e.g. Thanks for the great streams!
tips.public.net_warn: Donation goals and alerts use the amount that arrives after fees have been deducted.
tips.public.no_goal_hint: Arrives just the same, it simply does not count towards a progress bar.
tips.public.not_ready: No way to pay is set up here right now – nothing can be accepted at the moment.
tips.public.provider_hint: You will continue at %{name}. Payment happens there – nothing happens until then.
tips.public.provider_hint_many: You will continue at the chosen provider. Payment happens there – nothing happens until then.
tips.public.terms: I have read and accept the %{terms} and the %{privacy}. I confirm that I am at least 18 years old.
tips.public.why_login: The login only serves to show your name in the stream. No account is created.
tips.public_hint: This is the address you share:
tips.required_hint: Without these elements the bar shows nothing in the overlay – and that only becomes apparent mid-stream.
tips.reset_question: Discard your own markup and stylesheet and use the shipped one again?
tips.scope_hint: Keep your rules inside .goal-tip. An unscoped rule describes the same classes as the Twitch goals – then their bars look different depending on load order.
tips.settings_lead: Name, amounts and legal texts of the donation page at /tips.
tips.title: Name
tips.too_many: More than %{max} goals is no longer a list.
